verdict.rationale: Motion's docs describe multiple AI-generated insights derived from user data: priority highlighting, at-risk task/project flagging, project completion predictions based on team capacity, and an AI search assistant/workflow builder that surfaces insights from work data (motion-docs-4, motion-docs-11, motion-docs-39, motion-docs-40, motion-docs-22, motion-docs-23). These are first-party vendor claims with no independent hands-on verification of insight accuracy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and no detail on how suggestions are surfaced/explained to users beyond marketing copy.
